title: Jev is given a model list checked against what exists today, not the config as typed
name: live-list
description: Today `dispatch()` in packages/core/src/dispatch.ts hands `askJev` `config.dispatch.models` untouched, so Jev picks among entries that may be retired and never among free OpenRouter models listed since the config was written. Build the list Jev sees at dispatch time, in a new `candidatesFor(config, sources)` in packages/core/src/models.ts, per the `list-source` decision: for `pruned`, drop opencode entries absent from `openRouterModels()` and codex entries absent from `codexModels()`, log each drop through the dispatch log line (`packages/core/src/log.ts` or wherever `run.started` is written); for `discover`, also append every free text-out OpenRouter model not already named, with the range from a new `dispatch.discover` setting in packages/core/src/config.ts (default `{}` — nothing discovered unless asked), and write an ADR amending 0061 for whichever was chosen. The catalogue fetch is best-effort with a cache in `.sober/local/catalogue.json` (TTL a config knob, default one hour): unreachable, it logs and uses the config list as-is — an OpenRouter outage never stops a dispatch. Inject `fetch`/home as the existing functions do so tests need no network. Tests: models.test.ts covers prune, discover, cache hit, cache miss, fetch failure; dispatch.test.ts shows Jev receives the built list and the log names the drops.
